title: Overnight Glucose Stability Score
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:glucose overnight_profile=* stability_score=*
| stats avg(stability_score) as avg_stability_score, count as events by overnight_profile
| sort - avg_stability_score
description: Shows average stability score by overnight profile for overnight glucose control.
value: Average stability score by overnight profile helps compare overnight glucose control across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `stability_score` on `health:glucose` events and normalize `overnight_profile` so Splunk can summarize performance by overnight profile.
visualization: Bar chart of average stability score by overnight profile.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds the average stability score for each overnight profile so you can see what works best for overnight glucose control.
